metadata.name: Reading-list import
metadata.description: One setup of a branch library's onboarding: where the schools' reading lists come from, which term they are for, and whether the branch holds their titles. Three myapp.step blocks over priv/fixtures/reading_list_import_screens.json, so the person setting it up may go back to the step before. Runnable alone, and written to run as a child of the onboarding: its root finishes with the outcome done.

datamodel.description: What the steps collected, keyed by question key. Each myapp.step writes responses.<key> for the keys it names, from the press that finished it.
